title: Backflow testing service: confirm eligibility, report filing, and closeout
description: A valid testing service matches an eligible tester to the correct assembly and ends with the required result and filing evidence.
prompt: What should a testing service explicitly promise before it is booked?
answer: A valid testing service matches an eligible tester to the correct assembly and ends with the required result and filing evidence. A visit alone is not the deliverable.
urgency: Escalate if the notice has a deadline, the asset list is uncertain, the program requires a specific credential, or the provider cannot state who files the result.
diagramAlt: Backflow service and compliance workflow reference
identifiers: The notice or utility record identifies the controlling program and due basis.
The tester credential requirement may differ from a contractor license or a directory listing.
One appointment can include several assemblies only when each one is identified and recorded.

choices.label: I have a notice or program requirement
choices.detail: Use the issuing program to verify deadline and filing requirements.

choices.label: The assembly failed or needs service
choices.detail: Document the device and define repair plus retest scope.

choices.label: I manage a commercial asset
choices.detail: Separate access, shutdown, testing, and closeout responsibilities.

steps.title: Establish the exact record
steps.body: Verify address, assembly location, model, and account before a tester is dispatched.

steps.title: Define the specific scope
steps.body: Ask whether the provider tests, repairs, retests, and files or only performs one of those steps.

steps.title: Prove the closeout
steps.body: Retain the passing or failed record and the proof that the required recipient received it.

safeChecks: Ask which portal or recipient receives the result.
Confirm whether repair authorization is separate from the test appointment.
Keep access instructions with the work order.
stopConditions: No eligible tester can be confirmed for the issuing program.
The report recipient or submission owner is unspecified.
notThisDevice: A generic service listing does not establish program eligibility.
A device family is not enough to identify compatible parts.
This page does not replace a qualified assessment or authority approval.
evidenceNote: Use the governing utility or authority requirement and exact manufacturer documentation to validate this specific decision path.
